The '''Soronsian Holox mark Null''' was a type of [[Imagecaster/Legends|imagecaster]] used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that could project [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] images. When used in conjunction with the [[Jedi beacon transceiver]], it could create a live image of an individual on the other end of the transceiver for communication.
